title: Quarterly Federal Government Revenue
description: Quarterly Federal Government revenue from direct taxes, indirect taxes, non-tax sources, as well as non-revenue receipts.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 since the data is at quarterly frequency

fields.name: category
fields.title: Category
fields.description: [Categorical] Overall revenue, direct taxes, indirect taxes, non-tax revenue, or non-revenue receipts

fields.name: variable
fields.title: Variable
fields.description: [String] Variable name, to be mapped using the [Lookup Table](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/lookup_federal_finance) where file = 'revenue'. The lookup table will give you the English and Malay definitions.

fields.name: value
fields.title: Value (RM mil)
fields.description: [Float] Amount of revenue in millions of ringgit (RM mil)

methodology:
This data is produced by the Accountant-General's Department in compliance with the [Malaysian Public Sector Accounting Standards](https://www2.anm.gov.my/akruan/Pages/MPSAS.aspx) and the IMF's Dissemination Standards. A few definitional nuances should be noted:
- Individual income taxes include collection of income taxes without codes which will eventually be appropriately classified.
- Prior to 2007, the value for other direct taxes includes revenue from the real property gains tax.
- Collection of revenue under the goods and services tax began on 1 April 2015.
- Effective 1 January 2000, the values for indirect sales tax includes revenue from the sales tax on petroleum and petroleum products, which replaced the import and excise duties on these products.
- Other indirect taxes include betting, sweepstakes and gaming taxes, as well as collection of revenue without codes which will eventually be appropriately classified.
- The value for non-tax interest and returns on investment includes profits from PETRONAS and Bank Negara Malaysia.
- The value for other non-tax revenue includes services fees, fines, and penalties.
caveat: Numbers may not add up due to rounding during derivation. Furthermore, data for 2023 are preliminary and are subject to revision in future releases.
